blurb: Pass Christian Harbor offers boat slip rentals including transient slips and live-aboard options. The harbor features public boat launches, a fishing pier, secured gated piers with security cameras, and public restrooms. Utility fees cover water, sewer pump out, electricity, Wi-Fi, trash service, and oil waste removal.
extraNote: Transient slip rental rate is $1.00 per foot plus 7% Mississippi state sales tax with a $25.00 plus tax minimum · Utility fees billed based on vessel length with minimum fees and sales tax applied · Permit required for all events held in parks, must be approved one business week before event · Harbor Masters Office at 115 S. Market St, Pass Christian, MS
